::: {.key-point}
Mock schedule for Spring 2027, based on the Spring 2026 course. Both MATH 563 and MATH 574 are assumed to meet on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Meeting times and rooms: TBD.** Topics, tests, assignment deadlines, and presentation dates below are tentative and await instructor review.
:::

## Calendar Basis

The [Illinois Tech academic calendar](https://www.iit.edu/registrar/academic-calendar), checked September 18, 2026, lists Spring courses beginning January 11, Spring Break March 15–20, the last day of courses May 1, and final examinations May 3–8. Under the Tuesday/Thursday assumption, this gives **30 regular meetings from January 12 through April 29**, with no meetings on March 16 or March 18.

The MLK holiday is Monday, January 18, so it does not remove a Tuesday/Thursday meeting. The final-exam schedule is due to be published March 10; the MATH 563 examination date, time, and room remain TBD.
